segments.thag2.46:1.1: “Nadanti morā susikhā supekhuṇā, sunīlagīvā sumukhā sugajjino;
segments.thag2.46:1.3: Susaddalā cāpi mahāmahī ayaṃ, subyāpitambu suvalāhakaṃ nabhaṃ.
segments.thag2.46:2.1: “Sukallarūpo sumanassa jhāyataṃ [jhāyitaṃ (syā. ka.)], sunikkamo sādhu subuddhasāsane;
segments.thag2.46:2.3: Susukkasukkaṃ nipuṇaṃ sududdasaṃ, phusāhi taṃ uttamamaccutaṃ padan”ti.
